I finally finished Sky-Scraper's Perler nemesis icon...but it looks pretty terrible.  I did what I could with the space and colors I had...

 

![](upload://cXJnLgMIXLK6Bi3VoM1y1nVDPx7.jpeg)

I also remade my Argent Adept Icon so it's a little less harsh on the eyes and more accurate.  At least three of the people I gave my creations to at the Gathering of Heroes wanted his symbol until I showed them the rather poor color scheme I chose when I was sleep deprived and clearly out of my mind.

![](upload://xS7dKwhJnuJ9ljw0Ne4YJAPbBmM.jpeg)


I've also remade a lot of the nemesis symbols I've given away over the past year or so.  I gave Tachyon to Christopher, Mister Fixer to Paul, Fanatic to Adam (and fixed an out of place black Perler bead on my original), Unity to Jodie, Absolute Zero to Russ (Rabit), Nightmist to Andy (Arenson9, but this new one has glow-in-the-dark beads), and Legacy to Craig (and I haven't made another one yet because I need to revise my design...).

This is actually my third Expatriette nemesis symbol, as I gave the first (along with my Setback symbol) to Under3 in an art trade for some amazing Little Big Sentinels figures, and the second to a friend who moved out of state, as she is his favorite!

![](upload://inxhMrsnZWRt4MXi7Qze3b0jFsQ.jpeg)


If I've mixed up any of the recipients I apologize!  The Gathering of Heroes was a blast but it was over before I knew it and was very hard to keep track of everything!
